records.description: Google data centre location in Dublin. Google states that it announced the Profile Park site in 2011 and opened its first Dublin data centre in 2012.

records.name: Meta Richland Parish Data Center
records.coordinate_precision: approximate Richland Parish-area map pin; not an individual building coordinate
records.description: Large Meta data center campus under development in Richland Parish, Louisiana. Meta describes the site as a four-million-square-foot campus intended to house its multi-gigawatt Hyperion AI training cluster.

sources.title: One Year In: Meta's Richland Parish Data Center Supports Louisiana Economy With $875M In Contracts

records.name: Microsoft Fairwater AI Data Center
records.coordinate_precision: approximate Mount Pleasant-area map pin; not an individual building coordinate
records.description: Microsoft's Fairwater AI data center campus in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin, built for large-scale AI computing. Microsoft reported that its first facility was complete in June 2026, with construction continuing on an adjacent second facility.

sources.title: Microsoft completes construction on first datacenter facility in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin

records.name: xAI Colossus — Memphis

sources.title: Building the Future of Intelligence in Memphis

records.name: Google data centre campus — Council Bluffs
records.coordinate_precision: approximate Council Bluffs-area pin; not an individual building coordinate
records.description: Google data centre campus in Council Bluffs, Iowa, where the company says it has operated since 2007. Google announced a further investment to expand Council Bluffs and develop a separate new data centre campus in Cedar Rapids; this record refers to Council Bluffs only.

records.name: Switch Citadel Campus — Tahoe Reno
records.coordinate_precision: approximate Tahoe Reno Industrial Center-area pin; not an individual building coordinate
records.description: Switch's colocation data centre campus in the Tahoe Reno region of Nevada. Switch describes a multi-gigawatt expansion and states that gigawatts of power capacity are planned upon completion; that is a future campus plan, not an assertion of current installed capacity.

sources.title: Tahoe Reno Exascale Data Center Ecosystems
